instruction: Compare iPad Pro 12.9-inch with iPad Pro 11-inch and iPad Air

metadata.explanation: Variation comparing iPad models using the same Apple comparison interface. The agent needs to navigate to the iPad comparison page and select the three specified models: iPad Pro 12.9-inch, iPad Pro 11-inch, and iPad Air. Uses existing evaluator that parses the modelList parameter from the active tab URL.
metadata.verification: The expected modelList values match Apple's URL parameter format for iPad models. Similar to the original iPhone comparison task, maintaining similar complexity and interaction pattern.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: get_active_tab_url_parse extracts URL from accessibility tree, parses the modelList query parameter, and splits it by comma
Metric logic is correct: check_direct_json_object compares the extracted modelList against expected values with ignore_list_order flag to allow any ordering
Complete coverage: Evaluator checks for all three required iPad models (iPad Pro 12.9-inch, iPad Pro 11-inch, iPad Air) in the URL
Expected values are correct: Model identifiers (ipad-pro-12-9, ipad-pro-11, ipad-air) match Apple's standard URL parameter format
Data flow is semantically correct: URL extraction → query parameter parsing → list splitting → comparison with expected list
State accessibility is good: Active tab URL is accessible via accessibility tree without requiring postconfig
Edge cases handled: Getter returns None if required parameters are missing, which is properly handled by the metric
